findings.evidence: addons/intelligence/app/routers/document_text.py: new _page_ocr_texts(file_id) querying PdfPageOcrText, and get_document_text calling asyncio.to_thread(_page_ocr_texts, file_id) when mime == document_text.PDF, then passing page_ocr_texts to document_text.extract_units. The touch points name only `app/document_text.py` for stored page texts.
